Title: Advertising Two Pi-hole DNS IP Addresses via DHCP | no dogma blog
Description: If your Pi-hole has two IP addresses on eth0 handling DNS, you can get its DHCP to advertise both addresses. This might block the client from using hardcoded secondary DNS IP addresses that would bypass the Pi-hole.
